nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the selfdestruct beneficiary in release().
IBancorChanger instance used to swap between the ether token and the smart token.
IEtherToken instance wrapping ETH; target of deposit/withdraw/approve/balanceOf calls.
ERC20 BNT token instance used to read balances.
ISmartToken instance obtained from tokenChanger.token(); used as swap counterparty.
Public mapping address => uint256 declared for position tracking (unused in logic).
Constructor; sets owner from msg.sender and initializes tokenChanger, etherToken, bnt and smartToken.
Payable function that deposits ETH into the ether token, approves and swaps it for the smart token, then transfers the result to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that selfdestructs the contract, sending remaining ETH to owner.
View helper returning the tokenChanger quote for etherToken -> smartToken.
View helper returning the tokenChanger quote for smartToken -> etherToken.
Generic view helper forwarding arbitrary token pair and amount to tokenChanger.getReturn.
Closes a long position by pulling the caller's BNT balance and swapping it back into the ether token through tokenChanger.
Unpermissioned function that performs a hardcoded tokenChanger.change of a fixed amount.
View helper quoting the swap of the caller's own smart-token balance back into the ether token.
Withdraws an arbitrary amount of ETH from the ether token contract to this contract.
View helper returning the etherToken balance of a given address.
View helper returning the BNT balance of a given address.
Empty function reserved for margin call logic; currently does nothing.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, token transfer destination and balance lookups.
Irreversible destruction of the contract sending all remaining ETH to owner.
External payable call that forwards msg.value into the ether token contract.
External call to the Bancor changer executing an actual swap of tokens.
External call transferring purchased smart tokens to the caller.
External call pulling ETH out of the ether token contract.
External view call into the Bancor changer to obtain swap quotes.
Amount forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn in getBuyReturn.
Amount forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn in getSellReturn.
Source token address forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
Destination token address forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
Amount forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
Amount passed to etherToken.withdraw.
Address whose etherToken balance is queried.
Address whose BNT balance is queried.
Local holding the smart token amount returned by tokenChanger.change inside long().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the tokenChanger state variable.
Constructor assigns the etherToken state variable.
Constructor assigns the bnt state variable.
Constructor assigns smartToken from tokenChanger.token().
Constructor derives the privileged owner role directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
long() makes an external payable call to etherToken.deposit.value(msg.value)().
long() makes an external call to tokenChanger.change before finishing its own state accounting.
long() makes an external call to smartToken.transfer to pay out the caller.
The untrusted msg.sender is the recipient of the tokens produced by the swap.
The value returned by tokenChanger.change is stored in the returnAmount local.
The returnAmount local is used as the amount of the smartToken.transfer call.
etherToken state variable is the target contract of the deposit call.
tokenChanger state variable is the contract invoked for the change call.
smartToken state variable is passed as the destination token of the change call.
release() reaches selfdestruct only after checking that msg.sender is the owner.
msg.sender drives the owner authorization that gates selfdestruct and receives the funds.
closeLong() calls the external tokenChanger.change using a caller-derived amount.
closeLong() calls the internal getBNTBalance helper.
getBNTBalance(msg.sender) is used as the swap amount in closeLong, so untrusted input reaches the external call.
moo() is unpermissioned and performs an external tokenChanger.change with a hardcoded amount.
withdraw() makes an external call to etherToken.withdraw without any access control.
The withdraw parameter returnAmount is passed directly into etherToken.withdraw.
getBuyReturn() delegates to the external tokenChanger.getReturn call.
getSellReturn() delegates to the external tokenChanger.getReturn call.
getReturn() delegates arbitrary tokens and amount to the external tokenChanger.getReturn call.
getReturn() uses the external tokenChanger.getReturn quote for the caller balance.
getBuyReturn._amount is forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
getSellReturn._amount is forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
getReturn._fromToken is forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
getReturn._toToken is forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
getReturn._amount is forwarded to tokenChanger.getReturn.
getETHBalance uses parameter a as the queried address.
getBNTBalance uses parameter a as the queried address.
getReturn() calls the internal getBNTBalance helper.
getReturn() passes msg.sender into getBNTBalance, letting the caller choose the quoted amount.
